description: Change publish settings of one of the user's own R3 projects in this environment — the app's Deploy → Settings. Only the settings named change (the rest stay as they are). Only when the user asked for it, or approved the text: these settings shape the PUBLIC live page — its title and description in search results and link previews (seoTitle, seoDescription), Works on (keyboard puts a "made for a keyboard" note on phones and a "desktop" badge; touch a "mobile" badge; both, both; untested none — set it only after the user confirmed it or it was tested, never from the code scan alone), how it starts, its controls. Invalid values are refused with every problem named, and nothing is saved. The answer names what changed; open live and preview pages are told (a preview reloads, a live page offers a reload). Takes effect without a new release. Needs the publish:live right.

settings.description: Only the settings to change, e.g. {"worksOn": "keyboard", "seoDescription": "…"}.

autoStart.description: How the live page starts: auto (the default: a Start button only when the project has sound or physics, else it starts on load), startButton (always a Start button), firstGesture (the first click anywhere), load (on load: physics and code only, no audio).

controls.description: The always-visible pause / resume buttons on the live page.

seoDescription.description: The description search engines and link previews show (up to 500 characters). Empty, they show a generic line.

seoTitle.description: The title search engines and link previews show (up to 200 characters).

worksOn.description: What the project works on: keyboard (desktop only — phone visitors see a "made for a keyboard" note and the project gets a "desktop" badge), touch ("mobile" badge), both, or untested (no note, no badge).

name: r3_publish_settings_set

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Change a project's publish settings
